Overview

Hradec Králové is a city in Hradec Králové with a population of 93,000. A historic city at the confluence of the Elbe and Orlice rivers, known for its beautiful Art Nouveau architecture and as a center of education. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
